title: sideritis × angustifolia var. meridionalis
intro: Sideritis × angustifolia var. meridionalis, commonly known as Spanish chamomile or white-clawed burnet, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, resulting from a hybridization of Sideritis angustifolia and Sideritis montana. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis × angustifolia var. meridionalis include analgesic, anti-spasmodic, and sedative effects, making it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in phytomedicine.
